notes: A5 (meta keywords, PARTIAL): already fixed in code by #29 (56324dd, 2026-10-24) which strips keywords from every page; buildMetadata in src/lib/seo/metadata.ts emits none. The live site still shows keywords only because production is stale (last deploy 2026-10-19). Deploying main clears A5 on all 11 pages. Not a code fix - a deploy.

B9 (IndexNow after every deploy, FAIL): BY-DESIGN DEVIATION, not a real gap. CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md document that runtime IndexNow submission was removed (490 x 429 in a week from Workers egress, 0% success) and the site intentionally relies on (a) the registered nightly indexnow-sync sweep of sitemap.xml and (b) manual `pnpm indexnow:submit <path>` after shipping a new static page. 'Never reintroduce a submission on a read path.' Do not add a CI submit step without the maintainer's call.

B7 (llms-full.txt, FAIL): REAL gap. Only /llms.txt exists (curated links). A full-content llms-full.txt would serve the AI-crawler strategy the site explicitly courts in robots.ts. New route: src/app/llms-full.txt/route.ts. Propose, non-trivial (inlines page bodies).

B1 (robots AI crawlers, PARTIAL): missing OAI-AdsBot. Note OAI-AdsBot is OpenAI's ADS crawler, not an answer/citation crawler; the robots.ts list is explicitly 'crawlers we welcome for citations'. Adding an ads bot may be off-intent. Optional.
title.too.long /fantasy-football (crawl warning): FALSE POSITIVE. Rendered title is 58 chars; the 62 count treats '&' as 5 chars. No fix needed.

J1 (Smart App Banner, FAIL) + J6 (AASA JSON, FAIL): real but low-impact for a web tool ranking on informational queries. AASA 404 means universal-link handoff to the iOS app does not resolve. Relevant only when the native app push is prioritised. Batch/defer.
G1/G2 (/p family homepage + sibling links, FAIL): /p/* are user-generated punishment-wheel result pages, orphaned by design (CLAUDE.md). Not a nav gap.
M1/M2 (docs/seo growth-plan + page-plans, FAIL): process docs, not user-facing. Low priority.
B5 (HTML sitemap, manual): none. Optional for a 38-page site; sitemap.xml + llms.txt cover discovery.
C9 (HowTo only on real procedures, manual): /league-id/espn and /league-id/sleeper are genuine step-by-step procedures; HowTo is appropriate. Pass.

H3/H4 (author + trust pages, manual): no /about, /methodology, /editorial-policy. The trust story here is open-source + the randomizer linked at commit SHA, not editorial bylines. Low priority for this product.
L1 (prebuild SEO gates, manual): none. src/lib/seo/metadata-length.test.ts covers title/description length in unit tests instead.
